summary: Phase C (Public Track Record + Smart 70%+ Alerts + Level-Up Lessons) verified end-to-end against the public preview URL. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass (test_phase_c_extras.py). Frontend: all required flows exercised on 390x844 mobile viewport while logged in as trader@optiscreen.app (Intermediate / Level 3+). (a) Track record — POST /api/screener/best-options with profile=low_low logs picks via db.picks (14 open picks visible on live tab after test runs); dedup on {ticker|strategy|expiration|strikes} key confirmed by repeat call producing no duplicates; GET /api/track-record returns the required {live:{stats,buckets,settled,open,open_count,method}, backtest:{status,...}} shape with buckets labelled 70–80% / 80–90% / 90–100%. Backtest moved from pending→ready within ~60s of first poll; final payload: status='ready', 153 trades across 11 tickers, win_rate 96.1%, by_strategy breakdown (Cash Secured Put 132/98.5%, Iron Condor 17/88.2%, Bull Put Spread 4/50%), 25 recent trades, method text includes 'Backtest' and 'Hypothetical'. (b) Smart alerts — POST /api/alerts/add {ticker:'ALL', kind:'smart_setup', note:'low_low'} works without threshold (threshold=null in response); POST /api/alerts/smart/check: with no active smart alert returns 400 'Turn on a 70%+ setups alert first'; with alert active, repeated calls (5x) produced exactly 3 events for today (per-day cap honored) and the 24h ticker+strategy+expiration dedup prevented duplicates; every event has pop>=70 and strategy is Level-3 appropriate (none of Sell Put/Sell Call/Short Strangle). GET /api/alerts/feed returns {items,max_per_day:3,market_open}. (c) Lessons — GET /api/learn/levels returns 4 levels with unlocked_for_trading=true for 1/2/3 and false for 4 (user is level 3), plus 'Lessons don't change your options level…' note; GET /api/learn/levels/{1..4} returns lessons + quiz with answer/explain stripped; POST /api/learn/levels/{n}/quiz with the stated correct answer vectors (L1 [0,2,1], L2 [1,0,1], L3 [1,1,0], L4 [2,1,1]) returns score=3 total=3 passed=true for each level; wrong answers return passed=false with per-question answer+explain in results; wrong length → 400; unknown level → 404 on both GET and POST. Progress persisted — subsequent /api/learn/levels call reports passed=true, best_score=3 for all 4 levels. Frontend verified: Discover 'open-track-record' link opens /track-record; track-tab-live and track-tab-backtest both render with Live Picks default; switching to Backtest shows the 'Hypothetical backtest — not live trades' banner + win-rate card + buckets with 70–80/80–90/90–100% rows + By strategy breakdown + Recent backtest trades; track-back returns to Discover. Alerts: add-alert opens modal; selecting alert-kind-smart_setup hides alert-ticker input and reveals smart-profile-* chips; after alert-create, smart-feed section appears with smart-check-now button and 3 feed-* rows (New 92% POP META / New 74% POP TSLA / New 72% POP AAPL — all strategies allowed for Level 3). Tapping the first feed row navigates to /analyze?ticker=META&strategy=Cash%20Secured%20Put&range=month and the Analyze screen loads the ticker. Learn: level-path section renders with level-1..level-4 rows showing lesson count + quiz best score + 'your level' / 'locked for trading' labels and a '4/4 BADGES' header; tapping level-1 opens /lesson/1 showing 3 lesson-card-* cards + 3 quiz questions; selecting quiz-{q}-{o} and quiz-submit returns a quiz-result card with no quiz-retry on correct answers; after passing, the Learn screen shows DONE badges on all 4 levels (test case-sensitivity false negative — screenshot confirms); wrong-answer run on Level 2 renders quiz-retry as expected. React Native: no red screen, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage; expo-notifications push gracefully skipped on web preview as documented.
critical_code_review_comments: extras.log_picks uses $setOnInsert with a composed key ({ticker|strategy|expiration|strikes}) so a Discover re-scan never duplicates picks — matches the review requirement.
settle_open_picks only triggers when expiration < today, uses real closing price from get_candles and computes P&L via payoff_exp minus fees — matches the 'settle at expiry vs actual close' spec.

compute_backtest filters to tickers with >=50 candles and runs in a background thread via asyncio.to_thread — won't block the event loop. The method string is clearly labelled 'Hypothetical — not live trades' and the UI surfaces it verbatim.

smart_check_user enforces MAX_SMART_ALERTS_PER_DAY=3 using a NY-timezone start-of-day boundary (count via db.alert_events) and dedups within 24h on ticker|strategy|expiration — both caps verified across 5 consecutive /smart/check calls.
alerts_smart_check correctly rejects callers with no active smart_setup alert with HTTP 400 and the exact message surfaced in the UI.

learn_quiz hides answer+explain on GET /learn/levels/{n} and only returns them inside the POST response — good to avoid cheat-via-devtools. Progress is upserted with max(score, prev) and sticky passed flag.
Backtest payload includes by_strategy aggregate and recent trades with entry/exit dates & prices — the UI uses these directly, no extra transforms needed.
extras.register wires log_picks to run as a fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task from /api/screener/best-options — a persistent pick DB write failure won't block the user response.
No MongoDB _id leaks: every find() in extras.py uses projection {_id: 0, ...}.
seed_data_creation: Transient: 1 smart_setup alert created & deleted per test run; 14 open picks logged from Discover scans (will self-settle at expiration); 4 lesson_progress rows (level 1..4, passed=true, best_score=3) written for the trader user. Per the agent-to-agent note these may be deleted, but they are harmless and reflect realistic usage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iterations 6/7/8/9 all green — Phase A (engine), Profile fix, Phase B (level gating & 70% POP floor) and now Phase C (track record + smart alerts + lessons) are production-ready. Backtest payload becomes 'ready' ~60s after a cold backend start (not 90s as the review stated — compute_backtest runs after a 90s sleep AND then takes a few more seconds to compute). If future tests need to verify Level 4 locked state, call POST /api/user/questionnaire with options_level='Level 1-2' before scanning — Learn then reports unlocked_for_trading=false for levels 3 and 4.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — feature verification run, no bugs found.
